calibration_sources: Azure AI Foundry Provisioned Throughput Units (PTU) vs. Pay-As-You-Go Architecture & Spillover Reference Patterns
AWS Bedrock Provisioned Throughput vs. On-Demand Token Pricing & Burst Routing Guidelines
Kubernetes AI Toolchain Operator (KAITO) + KEDA + vLLM V1 Enterprise GPU Serving TCO & Utilization Benchmarks

workload.enterprise_scenario: 5,000-Employee Enterprise Copilot & Customer Assistant (4,000 Input + 500 Output Tokens/Req, 12B Total Tokens/Month)
workload.traffic_profile: Steady Average 120 RPM, Business Daytime Peak 420 RPM (3.5x Peak-to-Average Ratio), SLA: P99 TTFT <= 800 ms, P99 TPOT <= 25.0 ms, HTTP 429 <= 0.1%
workload.breakeven_rules: PAYGO optimal below 1.5B tok/mo (<18% utilization); PTU/Self-Hosted breakeven crossed at >=30-35% steady utilization; Hybrid Base+Burst saves 73.7% vs Peak-Sized PTU.

tiers.name: Tier 1: 纯 Serverless API 按量计费 (MaaS PAYGO Only · 零预留起步)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Pure Serverless API Pay-As-You-Go (MaaS PAYGO Only · Zero Commitment)
tiers.deployment_stack: Public Cloud MaaS PAYGO Endpoint (Shared Multi-Tenant TPM/RPM Quota)
tiers.recommended_for: Early PoC, spiky/low-volume apps (<1.5B tokens/month or <15% steady utilization), or zero-SRE startups.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 按峰值 100% 静态采购预留吞吐 (Full-Peak Azure PTU / Bedrock Provisioned)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Full-Peak Static Provisioned Throughput (100% Peak-Sized PTU / Provisioned)
tiers.deployment_stack: Dedicated Cloud PTU / Provisioned Units Sized for 420 RPM Daytime Peak (68% Night/Off-Peak Idle Waste)
tiers.recommended_for: Anti-pattern when traffic has >2x diurnal swing: sizing PTU for 100% peak wastes 68% capacity during off-peak hours.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 容器化自托管弹性 GPU 集群 (AKS + KAITO / KEDA + vLLM FP8 + Multi-LoRA)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Self-Hosted Elastic Kubernetes GPU Cluster (AKS + KAITO / KEDA + vLLM FP8)
tiers.deployment_stack: AKS + KAITO/KEDA Autoscaling + vLLM V1 (APC Prefix Cache + Multi-LoRA on Reserved H100/H200 + 0.5 FTE SRE)
tiers.recommended_for: Open-weight models (Qwen-2.5-72B / Llama-3.3-70B / DeepSeek), strict VPC data residency, custom LoRA weights, and >=3B tokens/mo.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 混合分层“稳态基荷 (PTU/AKS) + 峰值 PAYGO 自动溢出”架构 (AI Gateway Spillover)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Hybrid Base-Capacity (PTU/AKS at 86.5% Util) + Burst PAYGO Spillover via AI Gateway
tiers.deployment_stack: Base Capacity (78% Volume on Reserved PTU/AKS at 150 RPM) + AI Gateway 429/Token-Bucket Spillover to PAYGO (22% Burst)
tiers.recommended_for: Production enterprise standard: locks in 86.5% base utilization while absorbing 3.5x daytime spikes via zero-429 PAYGO spillover.
